original_value: Fictional ambient lighting sculpture for indoor décor and event staging. Frosted polycarbonate diffuser, programmable color cycles, silent convection cooling, and USB-C power input. Designed as a tabletop accent light with low-power LED illumination and a warm-to-cool scene mode.

result.paraphrase: Indoor décor and event staging are the intended uses for this fictional ambient lighting sculpture. It features a frosted polycarbonate diffuser, programmable color cycles, silent convection cooling, and USB-C power input. Designed as a tabletop accent light, it provides low-power LED illumination with a warm-to-cool scene mode.
